WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
calc AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) ns
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctrl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) cs
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id<900
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT c.fiscal_year, c.store_id, c.ns, k.cs, ROUND(c.ns-k.cs,2) diff
FROM calc c FULL JOIN ctrl k ON k.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year AND k.store_id=c.store_id
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(c.ns,0)-COALESCE(k.cs,0))>0.5 OR c.ns IS NULL OR k.cs IS NULL
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH wk AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date ws, fiscal_week_end_date we
  FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period=1 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
),
sw AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
    (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.ws) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.we)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date<=w.we AND c.closure_end_date>=w.ws) AS trading
  FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN wk w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id<900
),
sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(f.net_amount) gross_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id<900
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT sw.store_id, sw.store_name, sw.fiscal_year, sw.fiscal_week, sw.trading, COALESCE(sa.gross_net,0) sales
FROM sw LEFT JOIN sales sa USING (store_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_week)
WHERE (NOT sw.trading) OR sa.gross_net IS NULL OR sa.gross_net < 1000
ORDER BY 1,3,4

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
                FROM dim_date
                WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-05-04' - 364)
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct, ty.stores, ly.stores AS ly_stores
FROM lfl_sales ty, lfl_sales ly
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
